I choose option 3, a refund!    /Johan    26 okt. 2026 kl. 14:03 skrev HeliumDeploy <(email hidden)>:      ﻿ Hi Johan,  Thank you for ordering the Harlo H15 (Shop····).  We recently met with the manufacturer and went through every component of the unit, most of all the Scrypt chipset, which is the most expensive part of the miner. That review let us bring the retail price down by $200, from $999 to $799.  You paid the earlier price, so we owe you the difference: $200. Choose how you would like it:   Store credit of $200 on your account, for any future order.  A product of your choice worth $200 or more, with the $200 applied to its price.  A refund of $200 to your original payment method.   Just reply to this email with 1, 2 or 3 and we will take care of it.  There is also a change to the ship date. Thank you for your patience and your trust.  The HeliumDeploy team   Unsubscribe

Hi Johan,

Thanks for coming back to us, and noted: option 3, the $200 refund to your original payment method. That is recorded on Shop····, and a colleague is picking it up today to issue it. They will confirm by email once the money is on its way, and it takes a few business days to show after that.

On the shipping, I agree $471.86 looks high for a delivery to (address hidden), so I have asked the team to look at what was charged on your order and come back to you on it in the same reply. I would rather they check it properly than give you a quick answer here.

Nothing else on the order changes. Your Harlo H15 Dual ships by November 30, 2026, and the tracking goes to this address automatically.

Sorry again for the extra wait, and thank you for sticking with us.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
